title: fix(plugin-form): the top-level `fields` descriptions and the unresolved-member warning stop teaching `{ name }` as tolerated (objectui#11550)
body:
Part of #11550

Clause-②: no

The patch round of objectui#11550: the seat's decision A (comment `5970513384`) under triage ruling `5969880008` item 1, "the authoring faces stop teaching it". The card stays open after this merges: its governed guide PR objectui#11561 is still in flight, and the seat ends the card when both are in.

## What changes

- `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`: the `fields` input description of `object-form`, `view:form` and `embeddable-form` drops "; `{ name }` is tolerated" from "Bare field names to show, in order (each looked up in the object schema; …)". The `object-master-detail-form` one drops "(`{ name }` tolerated)" after "Members are bare field names". Every other sentence is unchanged.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`: the `warnUnresolvedTopLevelField` message drops "(`{ name }` is tolerated)". It still says "Top-level `fields` takes bare field-name strings", still names `sections[].fields` and `FormFieldSchema`, and still tells the author to use a bare field-name string or a `sections[].fields` entry. Its docblock now says the top level takes only bare field-name strings, and that a STORED `{ name }` entry still reads but is no authoring spelling.
- `.changeset/11550-fields-tolerated-teaching-dropped.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-form` `patch`, because the text ships (measured in `dist/` below).
- Not touched: the stored read (`SimpleObjectForm`'s `fieldsToShow` loop in `ObjectForm.tsx`, `buildFlatFields` in `flatFields.ts`), the section shape-3 entry, and `ObjectFormSchema`.

## Premise check, on `main` `072b7e8`

- Re-grep of `is tolerated` and `tolerated)` over `packages/plugin-form/src`: 6 hits, exactly the claimed sites (three identical descriptions, the master-detail one, the warning, its docblock). After this change: 0 hits.
- Repo-wide, no test, snapshot, README or docs page quotes either the description sentence or the warning sentence. The claim's lead "any test that pins that exact text" found none. The three warning pins (`objectFormFieldsMembers-8071`, `topLevelFieldsWarnCoverage-8847`, `flatFields.test.ts`) assert the substrings `{ field: 'note' }`, `sections[].fields`, `FormFieldSchema` and "top-level `fields`", and all four are kept.

## Verification, head `701ada6`

- Build closure, `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`: 11 packages built, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/` (repo-root form): `Test Files 163 passed (163)`, `Tests 1889 passed, 1 skipped (1890)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`: exit 0, with the script name echoed.
- `eslint .` in `packages/plugin-form` (the package's own `lint` script), JSON output: 203 files, 0 errors. The two edited files carry 22 and 10 warnings, the same counts as their `072b7e8` copies linted through stdin. The root config extends `tseslint.configs.recommended` and enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Shipped text: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form build`, no file in `dist/` contains `is tolerated`. The new warning sentence is in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.umd.cjs`, and the new description sentence appears 3 times in `dist/index.js`.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:control-bytes` OK; `check:new-line-citations` 0 new; `check:pending-changeset-literals` OK; `check-changeset-presence` (2 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset); `check-changeset-no-major`; `check-changeset-overwrite` (0 modified); `check-changeset-fixed`; `check:element-data-source-declaration`; `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answers NOT GOVERNED.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) asked for three pending paragraphs that name `sectionFields.ts` to be re-read. `9884-master-detail-fields-intersection.md` and `console-formpage-visible-predicates-5594.md` stay true. `8738-fields-warn-route1.md` stays true of the read but still says "`{ name }` tolerated": see the first acceptance note.

## Acceptance notes

- `.changeset/8738-fields-warn-route1.md` is still pending, so it publishes into the same CHANGELOG release as this patch. It says "Top-level `fields` reads only bare field-name strings (`{ name }` tolerated)". That is still true of the runtime read, but it is the one remaining shipped text that calls `{ name }` tolerated. It is not edited here. It is a changeset this change does not own (`check-changeset-overwrite` reports exactly that kind of edit), and it is outside the claimed file surface. The seat decides.
- `FlatFieldsContext.fields`' docblock in `flatFields.ts` still says "objects carrying one (`{ name }`)". It describes the kept read and is not exported; the seat already recorded it in `5970513384`. Not touched.
- The console ledger row `object-form.fields` in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` still calls the `{ name }` spelling "the read site's tolerance rather than a second contract". That is test prose about the pinned stored read, not an authoring face. Not touched.

## Left to CI

Repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the `pnpm test` shards (the console suites included; `registry-inputs-spec-parity` only asserts each description is non-empty), e2e and the performance budget.
